name: Haringey Fostering Service
notes: Name and fostering types from the council's Fostering Service Annual Report 2024/25 (council committee papers). Website and recruitment URLs seen as search results on haringey.gov.uk (not fetched). Haringey is one of the six boroughs (Barnet, Camden, Enfield, Hackney, Haringey, Islington) whose foster carer recruitment is provided through the shared North London Fostering Hub / Foster North London (https://www.fosternorthlondon.gov.uk), per Islington Council's fostering site; Haringey also publishes a 'North London fostering hub' page (https://haringey.gov.uk/children-young-people-families/childrens-social-care/fostering/fostering-blog/north-london-fostering-hub). areasServed: Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea

name: Kingston upon Thames Fostering
areasServed: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames
notes: Children's services for Kingston are delivered by Achieving for Children (AfC), which runs a 'Joint Fostering Service' for the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames and the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames (fostering Statement of Purpose 2017/18 published on richmond.gov.uk; that document also lists respite, task-centred/emergency, long-term, specialist and family-and-friends care). No Kingston council fostering page was found in search; the website recorded is the AfC fostering site as linked from Richmond council's fostering page (not fetched), and the email is AfC's fostering enquiries mailbox published on that page. Kingston council news page (2024) names short-term, long-term, emergency and short-break arrangements. No phone or address confirmed. See also richmond-upon-thames-council-fostering.

name: Richmond upon Thames Fostering

name: Waltham Forest Fostering
notes: Council states it is part of the Local Community Fostering service, a network of four north-east London boroughs (Havering, Redbridge, Tower Hamlets and Waltham Forest per Redbridge council's page); applications are via the short form on the hub site (council links it as http://www.localcommunityfostering.co.uk/). The phone number published is the same number published by Redbridge, i.e. the shared hub line. Council also links a 'Fostering with Waltham Forest' site at https://fosteringwalthamforest.co.uk/ (not fetched) and publishes a Local Community Fostering privacy notice. Types stated: short-term emergency care and longer-term/permanent arrangements. No email or address on the page.
